Senior Backend Engineer at Acme

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our distributed infrastructure team.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with Node.js and TypeScript (must)
- Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL and Redis caching strategies (must)
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production (must)
- Track record of mentoring junior engineers and leading code reviews (must)
- Bonus points for experience with Go or Rust (nice to have)
- Familiarity with Apache Kafka or event-driven streaming is a plus (nice to have)

Full Stack Engineer

PostHog is looking for a product-minded Full Stack Engineer.
- Proficiency in Python / Django and React / TypeScript
- Experience building data-intensive user interfaces
- Strong ownership mindset and open-source contribution history is preferred

React Developer needed.
Must know modern React, Redux, and CSS.

DevOps Engineer
- AWS VPC, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines
- Linux system administration and incident response

Staff AI Engineer
- LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, Vector search (must)
- Distributed model training on GPU clusters (must)
- Published research papers are a strong plus (nice)
